description: Insert DynamicBorder separators into Interactive.render/2 layout assembly. Place one separator line above the transcript area (below any future banner) and one between the transcript and the input area. This replaces the current blank-line separator between transcript and input. The render pipeline becomes: [top_border] ++ transcript_lines ++ [bottom_border] ++ input_lines → Viewport.window → append footer. Depends on opi-j50.2 (DynamicBorder component).
title: Wire separators into Interactive layout
